Foreign Relations of the United States, 1969–1976, Volume

241. Telegram 3666 From the
Embassy in
                                India
to the
Department of
                                State
1
2
New Delhi
,
March 23, 1972, 1550Z
Subject:
GOP
Offer of Military Facilities in
                                Pakistan
REF:
A) State 49598
B) Islamabad 2213
C) Islamabad 2247
1. Apparent
GOP
decision to seek replay
                            history of substantial
US
military supply
                            and collaboration against India strikes me as ominously irrational and,
                            if pursued, certain to prejudice prospects for durable peace in South
                            Asia.
2. I hope this Embassy will re consulted before any serious consideration
                            is given to the proposals contained reftels.
Keating
